name: The Horn of the Beast
summary: In Searing Gorge, Margol the Rager's horn bears a broken axe head.

sections.title: A Shattered Clue
sections.body: Margol the Rager's horn is scratched and cracked. A broken axe head is lodged in its rough surface, and Mountaineer Pebblebitty's name marks the metal. When you try to free it, the axe head shatters into a million pieces.

sections.title: The Gate
sections.body: Stonewrought Pass runs between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge. The horn begins the chain that opens the gate, and you are to take it to Mountaineer Pebblebitty. Pebblebitty is not willing to open the gate.

sections.title: At the Gate
sections.body: Mountaineer Pebblebitty calls the horn an obvious fake. Pebblebitty has faced Margol and says her horn is far bigger than yours, at least eight times its size. Pebblebitty says yours probably came from a stormsnout in the Barrens.

faq.q: Where does this horn come from?
aliases: where do i find the horn
faq.answer: Margol the Rager's horn comes from Searing Gorge.
Mountaineer Pebblebitty is the mountaineer you are to take the horn to. Pebblebitty is unwilling to open the gate.

faq.q: What happens to the axe head in the horn?
aliases: why was pebblebitty axe in the horn
faq.answer: The axe head bears Mountaineer Pebblebitty's name. When you try to free it, it shatters into a million pieces.

faq.q: What does the horn lead to?
aliases: what is the key to searing gorge
faq.answer: The horn begins the chain that opens Stonewrought Pass between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge.
